name: io.github.GeminiGeorge22/company-social-mcp
title: Company Social MCP: Website to LinkedIn & Social Links
description: Find a company's LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook profiles from its website or name.

environmentVariables.name: APIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your own Apify API token. Needed for tools/call; tools/list works without it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional if you use Apify OAuth. Otherwise: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN> (your own Apify API token).
